zh.subject: knowledge 写动词的 CAS 用 store marker 版本,不是链版本
zh.summary: 引擎 knowledge-create/promote/retire/rebase/reverify 全部以 store.json 的 version 做 CAS;仪式按链版本供给会 KNOWLEDGE_CAS_MISMATCH。
zh.snippet: knowledge-marker-cas:knowledge 写动词 CAS 用 marker。

en.subject: Knowledge write verbs' CAS uses the store marker version, not the chain version
en.summary: The engine's knowledge-create/promote/retire/rebase/reverify all use store.json's version field for CAS; supplying the chain version to the ceremony causes KNOWLEDGE_CAS_MISMATCH.
en.snippet: knowledge-marker-cas: knowledge write verbs use the marker for CAS.

zh.subject: hook 注册必须用 ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} 形态,禁止裸相对路径
zh.summary: INC-040 死因:注册用裸相对路径致 hook 从未启动;活性门须执行注册字符串本身,不起进程冒充。
zh.snippet: hook-cwd-trap:注册用 ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR},活性门执行注册字符串。

en.subject: Hook registration must use the ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} form; bare relative paths are forbidden
en.summary: Cause of death for INC-040: registering with a bare relative path meant the hook never started; a liveness gate must execute the registration string itself, not stand in with a substitute process.
en.snippet: hook-cwd-trap: register with ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}; the liveness gate executes the registration string itself.

zh.subject: 远程 argv 经 ssh 重新拼接,必须 shellQuote
zh.summary: ssh 把远程 argv 以空格重拼并交给登录 shell,含空格/括号的值会成为远程语法错误;一律 shellQuote。
zh.snippet: ssh-shellquote:远程参数一律引号包裹。

en.subject: The remote argv is re-concatenated over SSH, so values must be shellQuoted
en.summary: SSH rejoins the remote argv with spaces and passes it to the login shell; values containing spaces or parentheses become remote syntax errors -- always shellQuote them.
en.snippet: ssh-shellquote: always shellQuote remote arguments.

zh.subject: SSH 直驱只两类 break-glass:主机 MCP 不可达 fallback 与按设计绕开服务层的逐字节比对
zh.summary: D1/D9 白名单:两类残余适用场景,每条带日期理由;白名单被 doc-topology 与 ssh-write-observer 共同消费。
zh.snippet: ssh-breakglass-two-classes:只两类白名单。

en.subject: Direct SSH driving has only two break-glass classes: host MCP unreachable fallback, and byte-for-byte comparison that bypasses the service layer by design
en.summary: D1/D9 allowlist: two remaining applicable scenarios, each with a dated justification; the allowlist is consumed jointly by doc-topology and ssh-write-observer.
en.snippet: ssh-breakglass-two-classes: only two allowlisted classes.

zh.subject: 探针身份也是量具:匿名 404≠不存在
zh.summary: 对存在性/可见性下结论前先问「我用什么身份在问」;有登录态先问认证面。
zh.snippet: probe-identity:先问自己用什么身份在问。

en.subject: The probe's identity is itself part of the instrument: an anonymous 404 does not mean nonexistent
en.summary: Before concluding on existence or visibility, first ask 'what identity am I asking as'; where auth state is involved, check the authentication surface first.
en.snippet: probe-identity: first ask what identity you are asking as.

zh.subject: 提交引用的简写形式对五分之二的记录键存在歧义
zh.summary: 各分区独立编号,所以 INIT-009 在每个分区里指向不同记录。公约要求使用完整外部键;简写形式的使用频率是完整键的四倍,却无法唯一定位所属链。
zh.snippet: 2026-08-19 对 609 条已完成跨项目记录的实测:11.2% 引用完整键,43.5% 引用简写形式,56.5% 未引用。609 个简写中有 242 个跨分区冲突。

en.subject: The short commit-citation form is ambiguous for two record keys in five
en.summary: Partitions number independently, so INIT-009 names a different record in each. The convention requires the full external key; the short form is four times more common and cannot identify a chain.
en.snippet: Measured 2026-08-19 over 609 completed cross-project records: 11.2 percent cite the full key, 43.5 percent the short form, 56.5 percent nothing. 242 of 609 short forms collide across partitions.

zh.subject: 上下文将满不是收尾的理由
zh.summary: 压缩自动发生;停下的正当理由只有实质阻塞(owner_intent_required/对外发布/硬阻断),不是资源余量。
zh.snippet: context-limit-is-not-a-reason-to-stop:停只因实质阻塞。

en.subject: Context nearing full is not a reason to wrap up
en.summary: Compaction happens automatically; the only legitimate reasons to stop are substantive blockers (owner_intent_required / external publication / a hard block), not remaining resource headroom.
en.snippet: context-limit-is-not-a-reason-to-stop: stop only for a substantive blocker.

zh.subject: guard-check 运行期间会把注入的变异真实写入工作树
zh.summary: guard-check 运行期间,任何并发的门或文件编辑都会读到一棵被蓄意破坏的树,运行期间发生的编辑会使其判定结果失效。
zh.snippet: 2026-08-19 与 guard-check 并行跑 verify-portal 产生了六个假红的 portal 案例。应将其当作互斥操作:等待该 pid 结束,并在继续前确认变异已被恢复。

en.subject: guard-check writes its injected mutations into the live working tree while it runs
en.summary: Any concurrent gate run or file edit during guard-check reads a deliberately broken tree, and edits made during the run invalidate its verdict.
en.snippet: Running verify-portal alongside guard-check produced six false red portal cases on 2026-08-19. Treat it as exclusive, wait on the pid, and confirm the mutation is restored before continuing.

zh.subject: 门的判定必须宿主无关
zh.summary: 一个输入若不在所有会运行该门的宿主上在场,就不能进判决;跨仓那半降 observation 或上移到看得见两仓的层
zh.snippet: 判定按宿主而异即选错参照物;拆问题,不列豁免名册

en.subject: A gate's verdict must be host-independent
en.summary: An input cannot enter the verdict unless it is present on every host that runs the gate; the cross-repo half either downgrades to observation or moves up to a layer that can see both repos.
en.snippet: A verdict that varies by host means the wrong reference object was chosen; split the problem, don't maintain an exemption roster.

zh.subject: 两天内四次误读,共同原因都是所问的问题比实际要回答的问题更窄
zh.summary: 每次测量所用的工具都只能返回已经预期的答案。识别标志是:探针的范围比它被用来支撑的结论更窄。
zh.snippet: 空的 knowledge store 其实是搜索时没有匹配卡片;被判丢失的 scope 字段其实是读错了 receipt 路径;11.2% 的可追溯性只测了两种引用写法中的一种;一个对负载敏感的测试仅凭两次孤立运行就被判定为 flake。

en.subject: Four wrong readings in two days all came from asking a narrower question than the one being answered
en.summary: Each measurement used an instrument that could only return the answer already expected. The tell is that the probe's scope is narrower than the claim it is used to support.
en.snippet: Empty knowledge store read off a search with no matching card; a dropped scope field read off the wrong receipt path; 11.2 percent traceability measured on one of two citation spellings; a load-sensitive test declared a flake from two isolated runs.

zh.subject: 文档里的举例就是断言
zh.summary: 公约点名一个实例等于对它的当下状态下了无人维护的判断;举例用类别,点名实例须写「截至某日实测」并给复核命令。
zh.snippet: example-in-convention-is-an-assertion:举例用类别,点名实例带日期与复核命令。

en.subject: An example in a document is itself an assertion
en.summary: A convention that names a specific instance is making an unmaintained claim about that instance's current state; use a category for examples, and when naming a specific instance, state 'measured as of [date]' with a recheck command.
en.snippet: example-in-convention-is-an-assertion: use categories for examples; a named instance carries a date and a recheck command.

zh.subject: 树里对不代表记录对(INC-039)
zh.summary: 声明块在工作树对、未提交,HEAD 仍错;committed-claims 判据要求已提交声明块与工作树一致。
zh.snippet: committed-claims:声明块须已提交,不只在工作树。

en.subject: Correct in the working tree does not mean the record is correct (INC-039)
en.summary: A claim block can be correct in the working tree yet uncommitted, leaving HEAD still wrong; the committed-claims criterion requires the committed claim block to match the working tree.
en.snippet: committed-claims: the claim block must be committed, not merely present in the working tree.

zh.subject: 任何链写入之后,knowledge 读取都会拒绝,除非显式要求容忍落后的 store
zh.summary: store 的 marker 必须等于链头,而每一次链上事件都会破坏这一点。在五个以元数据优先的读动词上传入 allow-trailing true,返回结果会同时带上两个头。
zh.snippet: 一次 work-create 曾让全部六个分区的 knowledge 读取全部失效,直到手动执行 rebase。自 TCRN-CROSS-INC-226 起,读动词接受 --allow-trailing true;写、validate 与 rebase 不在豁免之列。

en.subject: A knowledge read refuses after any chain write unless asked to tolerate a trailing store
en.summary: The store's marker must equal the chain head, and every chain event breaks that. Pass allow-trailing true on the five metadata-first read verbs; the answer then carries both heads.
en.snippet: One work-create took all six partitions' knowledge reads dark until a hand-run rebase. Reads accept --allow-trailing true since TCRN-CROSS-INC-226; writes, validate and rebase are not exempt.

zh.subject: 每次链写都拉开知识 store 标记差距,写路径必须自动 rebase
zh.summary: 知识 store 是 disposable 物化索引,每次链写使 eventHighWaterDigest 落后;仪式真写后自动 rebase 保持读面可用。
zh.snippet: marker-rebase-discipline:每写必 rebase。

en.subject: Every chain write widens the knowledge store's marker gap; the write path must auto-rebase
en.summary: The knowledge store is a disposable materialized index; every chain write leaves eventHighWaterDigest further behind. Auto-rebasing after a real ceremony write keeps the read surface usable.
en.snippet: marker-rebase-discipline: rebase after every write.

zh.subject: 凭据不是实现的前置
zh.summary: 凭据是运行期配置;需凭据的步骤单列,其余本地可完成可测,不让凭据阻塞实现。
zh.snippet: credentials-not-implementation-blocker:凭据单列,其余本地可完成。

en.subject: Credentials are not a prerequisite for implementation
en.summary: Credentials are runtime configuration; list the steps that need credentials separately, and complete and test everything else locally -- don't let credentials block implementation.
en.snippet: credentials-not-implementation-blocker: list credential-dependent steps separately; do the rest locally.

zh.subject: 报缺陷前先怀疑自己的探针
zh.summary: 平台累计十二次误报的共同根因是探针只看一侧或探针本身有误;报缺陷前先用已知好的输入校准探针。
zh.snippet: probe-before-defect:先校准探针,再报缺陷。

en.subject: Suspect your own probe before filing a defect
en.summary: The common root cause across twelve false-positive reports on the platform was a probe that only looked at one side, or was itself wrong; before filing a defect, calibrate the probe with a known-good input first.
en.snippet: probe-before-defect: calibrate the probe first, then file the defect.

zh.subject: 证据不得携带宿主路径(INC-037/042)
zh.summary: 仓内证据含本机 home 路径会让公开仓付出 93 提交改写代价;证据落盘必须 scrub,门扫 tracked+evidence 树。
zh.snippet: evidence-hygiene:证据 scrub 宿主路径,门扫 tracked+evidence。

en.subject: Evidence must not carry host paths (INC-037/042)
en.summary: In-repo evidence containing a local home path cost a public repo a 93-commit rewrite; evidence written to disk must be scrubbed, and the gate scans both the tracked tree and the evidence tree.
en.snippet: evidence-hygiene: scrub host paths from evidence; the gate scans tracked+evidence trees.

zh.subject: 多代理并发时每个都对,文件最后是错的
zh.summary: 并发代理各自局部正确,顺序写文件会互相覆盖;验证须重跑注释里的 MEASURED 连前提。
zh.snippet: agents-right-in-sequence-file-wrong:并发验证须重跑全部前提。

en.subject: With multiple agents running concurrently, each one is individually correct yet the file ends up wrong
en.summary: Concurrent agents are each locally correct, but writing the file in sequence causes them to overwrite each other; verification must rerun the MEASURED premises noted in the comments.
en.snippet: agents-right-in-sequence-file-wrong: concurrent verification must rerun every premise.

zh.subject: 在 knowledge 动词上,expected-version 指的是 store 自身的版本,而不是链版本
zh.summary: 其余所有动词都把该标志读作链版本。knowledge 动词却把它读作 knowledge store 的版本,而目录里没有任何地方区分这两种含义。
zh.snippet: 传入链版本 4295 时返回 KNOWLEDGE_CAS_MISMATCH 4295:160——前者是传入值,后者是期望值。读懂这条拒绝信息,不要再猜第二次。

en.subject: On the knowledge verbs, expected-version is the store's own version rather than the chain's
en.summary: Every other verb reads that flag as the chain version. The knowledge verbs read it as the knowledge store's version, and nothing in the catalog distinguishes the two meanings.
en.snippet: Passing chain version 4295 returned KNOWLEDGE_CAS_MISMATCH 4295:160 -- supplied first, expected second. Read the refusal rather than guessing a second time.

zh.subject: 门的判据须在每个会被评估的世界可满足
zh.summary: 联合不可满足的门永不绿;合并后那次 verify 不冗余。
zh.snippet: gate-must-be-satisfiable-everywhere:判据在每个评估世界都须可满足。

en.subject: A gate's criterion must be satisfiable in every world where it is evaluated
en.summary: A gate whose combined conditions are jointly unsatisfiable can never go green; the verify run after merging is not redundant.
en.snippet: gate-must-be-satisfiable-everywhere: the criterion must be satisfiable in every world it is evaluated in.

zh.subject: 没人读回来的写不算已证
zh.summary: 仪式载荷必须至少一条回读,且回读按全值比较,不是「读成功」。
zh.snippet: ceremony-readback:写必带回读,按全值比较。

en.subject: A write nobody reads back is not proven
en.summary: A ceremony payload must include at least one readback, and the readback must compare the full value, not merely 'the read succeeded'.
en.snippet: ceremony-readback: every write carries a readback, compared by full value.

zh.subject: 停顿预算只三类:owner_intent_required/对外发布/无裁定不可逆
zh.summary: 执行期必停只有三类;其余继续。
zh.snippet: stop-budget-three-classes:只三类必停。

en.subject: The stop budget has only three classes: owner_intent_required / external publication / irreversible without a ruling
en.summary: There are only three cases during execution that require a mandatory stop; everything else continues.
en.snippet: stop-budget-three-classes: only three classes require a mandatory stop.

queries.en: The version number I passed to knowledge-create is clearly the latest one on the chain -- why does it still report a version conflict?
The hook configured in settings.json never triggers, but running that same command by itself works fine -- why is that?
When I run a command remotely over SSH, arguments containing spaces and parentheses cause a syntax error on the remote end
This time I want to SSH directly into the server and operate manually instead of going through the usual process -- does that count as an allowed exception?
Some operations get blocked by the current tool's permissions or sandbox and simply can't be done -- what's the right way to handle this kind of constraint?
Calling this endpoint while not logged in returns a 404 -- does that prove the feature doesn't exist at all?
If I just write a short id like INIT-012 in a commit message to save trouble, without the project prefix, could it end up pointing to the wrong record later?
This session's context feels like it's about to hit the limit -- should I stop now and pick it back up next round?
